defects.title: Admin Payments page crashes (error boundary) whenever any rental payment belongs to a deleted booking
defects.evidence: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading _id) at Payments chunk, in the paymentTotals useMemo reduce (Array.reduce). Live data: 10 of 11 payments have booking === null (the annulled B1/B2/B3 residue pairs whose bookings were deleted by exact ID in those slices' cleanups; payments have no delete route). The only live-booking payment is the GAQ12B4 fixture. /bookings renders fine; /payments renders "Something went wrong." deterministically.
defects.rootCause: admin/src/pages/Payments.tsx line 115: typeof payment.booking === 'string' ? payment.booking : payment.booking._id - a null (deleted, populate-null) booking takes the object branch and derefs null. The reduce is the one B2 rewrote for D3 (Posted-only guard added at lines 112-114); the deref itself is older, but the crash only became reachable once queue #12 cleanups orphaned payments.
defects.fix: One-token null guard: payment.booking?._id (bookingId becomes undefined and the row is skipped by the existing if (bookingId) check, mirroring bookingIdOf/getBooking null handling elsewhere in the same file).

defects.title: Admin Payments table labels PENDING payments as Posted ("Comptabilisé")
defects.evidence: Payments.tsx statusLabel (line 257) returns strings.POSTED for every status except Reversed. The GAQ12B4 pending payment (API status pending) rendered in the table as "Comptabilisé" in all three B4 DOM scrapes, while the totals on the same page correctly excluded it. The pending status exists since the queue #10 confirmation workflow (decision 1.5); the label helper and the lang module only ever carried REVERSED/POSTED.
defects.rootCause: Two-state label helper predating the pending workflow; no PENDING string existed in admin/src/lang/payments.ts.
defects.fix: statusLabel now maps Pending -> strings.PENDING; PENDING added in en/fr/es/ar (Pending / En attente / Pendiente / قيد الانتظار). Display-only; totals logic untouched.

defects.title: Header notifications IconButton has no accessible name (axe button-name, critical) on every admin surface
defects.evidence: B4 axe sweep (queue #10 method, axe-core 4.10.2): fr and ar both report exactly 1 critical button-name node per admin surface (7/7), target .header-mobile > .MuiIconButton-root:nth-child(1); manual probe interactiveNoName=1 per surface. Desktop variant carries aria-label="" (empty), mobile variant carries no aria-label; the button contains only a Badge + SVG icon.
defects.rootCause: Pre-existing upstream BookCars header code - git shows Header.tsx identical to HEAD for these lines; no queue #10/#12 change introduced or touched them. The queue #10 sweep ran at a desktop viewport where .header-mobile is display:none, so the node was never visible to axe; the B4 sweep tab renders the mobile header, and B4 also adds the first ar admin pass. NOT a queue #12 regression.
defects.fix: aria-label={strings.NOTIFICATIONS} on both notification IconButtons; NOTIFICATIONS added to admin/src/lang/header.ts in fr/ar/en/es (Notifications / الإشعارات / Notifications / Notificaciones).
defects.status: fixed-in-source; build+layer+axe re-run in this slice
